## Open

### T-072 — `blong-kukum` phases 0–6 landed, with several follow-ups open

> _2026-09-12 · core/blong-kukum · open_

`blong-kukum` phases 0 to 6 landed. Implemented: shared layer and template tables, `mkdirSync` on
the platform API, `@feasibleone/blong-lint`, the realm, the pure engine, the 14-primitive catalogue
with templates, catalogue-driven routes and handlers, in-file agent instructions, registry
introspection (`Registry.describe()`, `Watch.describe()` and `IGateway.describe()`), the meta
endpoints (`primitive.find`, `method.find`, `tree.find`, `activation.find`, `instruction.find`,
`source.get`, `source.check`), the `kukum` CLI (`core/blong-kukum/bin/kukum.ts`), the MCP item
(`blong-gogo/src/Mcp.ts`, `/mcp`, off by default), full `realm` delegation to the `blong-kopi`
template, overwrite warnings on `add` and `edit`, and 427 assertions across `engine`, `operations`,
`index` (real gateway plus meta endpoints) and `scaffold` (scaffolds a realm, runs its own suite
green, then adds every primitive and kind). The skills rewrite is done: `[KUKUM_API]` is the
canonical section in `_shared/conventions.md` and all 17 skills reference it; `blong-realm`'s
hand-written file tree and `blong-validation`'s "hand-write `~.schema.ts`" instruction, which
contradicted the framework's own generation, were replaced.

Whole-file generators are done: `schema`, `model`, `seed` and the subject-named `*.play.ts` used to
replace the file rather than merge it, and `add` now composes when the target carries the generated
marker — a sibling `meta/type/<object>.ts` for tables, the spliced `tables` map for `register`, an
appended `test.describe` for playwright, plus auto-registered test groups — with `--replace` for a
deliberate reset. `seed` turned out to be a per-entity file (`<subject><Object>Merge.yaml`), so it
never needed merging. The `blong-graph` code side is done too: `orchestrator/graph.ts` declares the
`graph` namespace (`imports: [/\.graph$/]`), the handler moved to
`orchestrator/graph/graphGraphGet.ts` and reads `this.registry.describe()`, `adapter/` is gone,
`server.ts` no longer declares phantom children or an unconsumed `graphDispatch` config,
`browser.ts` imports the component source instead of a gitignored build artifact, and `ci-test` was
added (12 tap tests, lint clean). The E2E now lives in `e2e.test.ts` against a generated fixture at
`core/blong-kukum/test/fixture/e2e-realm/`, adds a second entity, runs all three legs and asserts an
artifact to test matrix; the generated files are gitignored and regenerated on every run, only the
Playwright baselines are committed, and they are now the drift lock. Coverage is 93.1% statements
and 93.5% functions, with the `kukum` CLI and `bin/fixture.ts` the main gaps.

Still open. The `blong-graph` Playwright spec cannot run as committed: `tests/fixtures` serves
`.tsx` from a plain `http-server` with no transpiler, the three baselines (`graph-initial-state`,
`graph-with-details`, `graph-node-types`) were never committed, and the `_ci-ui` script is not
invoked by blong's `rush.yaml`, so the visual test still never runs in CI. Fixing it needs a real
build step for the fixture plus committed baselines, or dropping the spec in favour of the tap test.
Unverified end-to-end as well: the realm-level round trip, loading a suite and reading
`/rpc/graph/graph/get`. The skills' verbatim skeleton blocks were kept deliberately as "what the API
emits" references, and deleting them is a separate editorial pass. Lost with the E2E change: the
byte-for-byte "committed fixture equals generated output" assertion, so a template change that
alters non-UI output such as a handler body, a seed or a config is no longer detected by this
package. MCP `/mcp`, the `kukum` CLI and `@feasibleone/blong-lint` still have no tests. Finally, the
committed fixture's own runner still executes as part of `node --run test` in `core/blong-kukum`:
tap's positional file globs, `'*.test.ts' '**/*.test.ts'`, are hard-coded in `blong-dev test` and
bypass tap's `exclude` rules entirely, so neither `--exclude` nor the `fixture/` folder convention
applies. `KUKUM_SKIP_E2E=1` does not skip it, it runs twice, and it requires the dev database where
the rest of the package may not.

### T-073 — The kukum e2e fixture is destroyed while tap may still be reading it

> _2026-09-12 · core/blong-kukum · open_

`e2e.test.ts` rebuilds `core/blong-kukum/test/fixture/e2e-realm/` from scratch on every run, and tap
also collects that fixture's own `index.test.ts` as part of the package suite. A kill
mid-regeneration left the tree empty and produced three cascading failures. Two candidate fixes were
proposed: generate into a sibling temp directory and swap it into place, so a reader only ever sees
a complete tree; or stop tap collecting the fixture at all.

The second was tested directly with `tap list '*.test.ts' '**/*.test.ts' --exclude='**/fixture/**'`:
the fixture test is still listed, which confirms that positional globs ignore `--exclude`. It
matches the four approaches already tried and recorded in `friction.md`, and the verdict is
unchanged — leave it alone. Option (a) does not fully fix it either, because any delete-and-replace
swap still leaves a window where the path does not exist. The real fix is for `blong-dev test` to
honour a package-level tap `include`/`exclude` config instead of hard-coding globs, a shared-tool
change with repo-wide blast radius. Do not re-litigate this without deciding to change
`blong-dev test`. It is the blocker before Stage 2, the split of `catalog.ts`.
